title: 第19章 冠军野望第20章 给自己加个脑子
slug: 符心护剑重建三十三重天
content_zh:
原来如此，苏醒仪式时的登记，竟还有这等深意。
苏醒脑海中念头飞转，将这段时间的所见所闻串联起来。
他收敛心神，郑重地开口问道：“老板，我有几个问题想确认一下，不知是否方便？”
“但说无妨。”
罗天威嘴角微扬，指尖轻弹雪茄，灰烬簌簌落下。
“我向来欣赏聪明又谨慎的年轻人，这样的人才能在修炼之路上走得更远。
毕竟，在这个世界上，活到最后的往往不是最强的，而是最谨慎的。”
苏醒深吸一口气，问出自己最关心的问题：
“这个新手大赛，只要是今年觉醒的人都能参加？也就是说，那些已经觉醒12个月的人，会和我这样才觉醒4个月的新人同台竞技？”
“规则确实如此。”
罗天威的目光中闪过一丝玩味，“怎么，感到压力了？但你要知道，觉醒时间长短固然重要，但天赋和悟性才是决定性的因素。
有些人觉醒一年，还不如别人觉醒一个月的进步大。”
苏醒若有所思，继续追问：“往届参赛选手中，最高达到什么位格？我想知道我需要面对的最强对手可能是什么水平。”
“历史上出现过黄金位格的天才，不过概率极低。”
罗天威微微前倾身体，雪茄的烟雾在空气中缭绕。
“绝大多数时候，白银位格就是顶尖水准。
今年尚未听说有黄金位格出现，但我不能完全保证。
毕竟，总有些势力喜欢隐藏自己的底牌，等到大赛时一鸣惊人。”
苏醒点点头，这个问题在他意料之中。
他接着问道：“参赛者都是三位一体的职业者吗？”

“这个问题没有意义。”
罗天威轻笑一声：“过去几十年里，能闯入决赛的，至少都掌握了本我和自我。
至于超我——”
他刻意停顿，语气变得深沉，“那些能够逆转战局的特殊天赋能力，通常不会在众目睽睽下施展。
毕竟，底牌可以救命。
不过，谁也不敢保证会不会有人破例，特别是在冠军奖励的诱惑下。”
苏醒记下这个重要信息，继续发问：“您提供的白银阶功法，在启点镇属于什么层次？与其他势力可能提供的功法相比，有什么优势？”
“堪称顶尖。”
罗天威语气中带着自信，手指轻轻敲击桌面，“至少我从未听说谁手中有黄金级功法——当然，除了我本人。”
苏醒沉吟片刻，问出最关键的问题：“为什么您认为我有夺冠的潜力？据我所知，启点镇每年觉醒的人不少，其中应该不乏天才。”
“三十天内将三个技能都修炼到10级，这等天赋，说是习武奇才也不为过。”
罗天威眼中精光一闪，“我这么多年见过的新人无数，能达到你这个程度的，不超过五指之数。”
“往届冠军大多是什么位阶？都是零阶吗？”
“绝大多数都是零阶。”
content_en:
It turns out that the registration during the awakening ceremony actually has such profound meaning.
Thoughts raced in Su Xing's mind, connecting what he had seen and heard during this period.
He calmed down and asked solemnly: "Boss, I have a few questions that I would like to confirm. Is it convenient?"
"But it doesn't matter."
Luo Tianwei raised the corner of his mouth slightly, flicked the cigar with his fingertips, and the ashes fell.
"I have always admired young people who are smart and cautious. Only such people can go further on the road of cultivation.
After all, in this world, those who survive to the end are often not the strongest, but the most cautious. "
Su Xing took a deep breath and asked the question he was most concerned about:
"In this novice competition, anyone who has awakened this year can participate? In other words, those who have been awakened for 12 months will compete with newcomers like me who have only been awakened for 4 months?"
"That's the rule."
Luo Tianwei's eyes flashed with amusement, "Why, are you feeling stressed? But you have to know that the length of awakening is important, but talent and understanding are the decisive factors.
One year for some people to awaken is not as great as the progress that others have made after one month of awakening. "
Su Xing was thoughtful and continued to ask: "What is the highest level among the previous contestants? I want to know what level the strongest opponent I need to face may be."
"There have been golden geniuses in history, but the probability is extremely low."
Luo Tianwei leaned forward slightly, cigar smoke lingering in the air.
“Most of the time, the silver level is the top level.
I haven’t heard of a golden spot appearing this year, but I can’t completely guarantee it.
After all, there are always some forces who like to hide their trump cards and wait until the big competition to make a splash. "
Su Xing nodded, this question was expected.
He then asked: “Are all the contestants Trinity professionals?”
"The question makes no sense."
Luo Tianwei chuckled: "In the past few decades, those who can reach the finals have at least mastered their identity and self.
As for the superego—"
He paused deliberately and his tone became deeper, "Those special talents that can reverse the situation of a battle are usually not used in public.
After all, trump cards can save lives.
However, no one can guarantee whether anyone will make an exception, especially with the temptation of championship rewards. "
Su Xing wrote down this important information and continued to ask: "What level does the silver-level technique you provide belong to in Qidian Town? What are its advantages compared with the techniques that other forces may provide?"
"It's top notch."
Luo Tianwei sounded confident as he tapped his fingers on the table, "At least I've never heard of anyone having a gold-level skill - except for me, of course."
Su Xing pondered for a moment and asked the most critical question: "Why do you think I have the potential to win the championship? As far as I know, there are many people awakening in Qidian Town every year, and there should be many geniuses among them."
"Cultivating all three skills to level 10 within thirty days. With such a talent, it is not an exaggeration to say that he is a martial arts prodigy."
Luo Tianwei's eyes flashed, "I have seen countless newcomers over the years, and there are only five fingers that can reach your level."
"What level are most of the previous champions? Are they all level zero?"
"The vast majority are level zero."
